Private Function Fill(ByVal wb As Object) As Object
    Dim ws As Object, i As Long
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:E1").Value = Array("Name", "Team", "Unit", "Qty", "Cost")
    For i = 2 To 9
        ws.Cells(i, 1).Value = "n" & i: ws.Cells(i, 2).Value = "t" & i: ws.Cells(i, 3).Value = "u" & i
        ws.Cells(i, 4).Value = i: ws.Cells(i, 5).Value = i * 2
    Next
    Set Fill = ws
End Function

Public Function Moved(ByVal edit As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, wo As Object, p As Object, q As Object, e As Object, w As Object, v As String, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets.Add After:=wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ws = Fill(wb)
    Set wo = wb.Worksheets(2)
    Set p = ws.Range("B3")
    Set q = ws.Range("B3:C5")
    Set e = ws.Rows(3)
    Set w = ws.Columns(2)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case edit
    Case 0
        ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 1
        ws.Rows(3).Insert
    Case 2
        ws.Rows(5).Insert
    Case 3
        ws.Rows("2:3").Insert
    Case 4
        ws.Rows(9).Insert
    Case 5
        ws.Rows(1).Delete
    Case 6
        ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Case 7
        ws.Rows(4).Delete
    Case 8
        ws.Rows("3:4").Delete
    Case 9
        ws.Rows("2:6").Delete
    Case 10
        ws.Rows("1:2").Delete
    Case 11
        ws.Rows(9).Delete
    Case 12
        ws.Columns(1).Insert
    Case 13
        ws.Columns(2).Insert
    Case 14
        ws.Columns(3).Insert
    Case 15
        ws.Columns(1).Delete
    Case 16
        ws.Columns(2).Delete
    Case 17
        ws.Columns("B:C").Delete
    Case 18
        ws.Columns("A:D").Delete
    Case 19
        ws.Range("B1").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 20
        ws.Range("B3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 22
        ws.Range("B1").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 23
        ws.Range("A3").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 24
        ws.Range("B3").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 25
        ws.Range("B1").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 26
        ws.Range("B3").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A1").Delete xlShiftToLeft
    Case 28
        ws.Range("A3").Delete xlShiftToLeft
    Case 29
        ws.Range("B3").Delete xlShiftToLeft
    Case 30
        ws.Range("B3:C4").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 31
        ws.Range("B3:C4").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 32
        ws.Range("A1:E1").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 33
        ws.Range("B3").Cut ws.Range("H1")
    Case 34
        ws.Range("B3:C4").Cut ws.Range("H1")
    Case 35
        ws.Range("B2:C5").Cut ws.Range("H1")
    Case 36
        ws.Range("A1").Cut ws.Range("B3")
    Case 37
        ws.Range("B3").Copy ws.Range("H1")
    Case 38
        ws.Range("B3").Clear
    Case 39
        ws.Range("B3:C4").ClearContents
    Case 40
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
    Case 41
        ws.Range("A1:E9").Sort ws.Range("A1"), xlDescending
    Case 42
        ws.Range("B3").Value = 1
    Case 43
        ws.Name = "Moved"
    Case 44
        wo.Move
    Case 45
        ws.Move After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count)
    Case 46
        wb.Worksheets.Add Before:=ws
    Case 47
        ws.Delete
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = p.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = q.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = e.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = w.Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = p.Worksheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = p.Value
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = q.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(p)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = p Is Nothing
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = p.Row
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = q.Rows.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = p.Offset(1).Address
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Moved = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Charted(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, ch As Object, s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = Fill(wb)
    ws.Range("H20").Select
    If which < 100 Then Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(10, 10, 200, 100).Chart
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A9,D1:D9")
    Case 1
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A9,D1:E9")
    Case 2
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A2:A9,D2:D9")
    Case 3
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("D1:D9,E1:E9")
    Case 4
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B9,D1:D9")
    Case 5
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:E1,A3:E3")
    Case 6
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:E1,A3:E4")
    Case 7
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A5,D1:D9")
    Case 8
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A9,D3:D9")
    Case 9
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("D1:D9,A1:A9")
    Case 10
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("E1:E9,A1:A9,D1:D9")
    Case 11
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1,D1")
    Case 12
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A9,D1:D9,B1:B9")
    Case 13
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:A9,A1:A9")
    Case 14
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("D2:D9,E2:E9")
    Case 15
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A:A,D:D")
    Case 16
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("1:1,3:3")
    Case 100
        ws.Range("A1:A9,D1:D9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 101
        ws.Range("A1:A9,D1:E9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 102
        ws.Range("A2:A9,D2:D9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 103
        ws.Range("D1:D9,E1:E9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 104
        ws.Range("A1:B9,D1:D9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 105
        ws.Range("A1:E1,A3:E3").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 106
        ws.Range("A1:E1,A3:E4").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 107
        ws.Range("A1:A5,D1:D9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 108
        ws.Range("A1:A9,D3:D9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 109
        ws.Range("D1:D9,A1:A9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 110
        ws.Range("E1:E9,A1:A9,D1:D9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 111
        ws.Range("A1,D1").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 112
        ws.Range("A1:A9,D1:D9,B1:B9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 113
        ws.Range("A1:A9,A1:A9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 114
        ws.Range("D2:D9,E2:E9").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 115
        ws.Range("A:A,D:D").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    Case 116
        ws.Range("1:1,3:3").Select: Set ch = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
    End Select
    s = "ok " & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & ch.PlotBy
    For i = 1 To ch.SeriesCollection.Count
        s = s & "|" & ch.SeriesCollection(i).Formula
    Next
Answered:
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Charted = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Answered
End Function
